description: Mobile product persist: the mobile AddProduct/EditProduct flow builds a ProductMaster and passes it to onSaved, but src/navigation/ProductNavigator.tsx wires onSaved to only navigation.goBack() — so mobile edits never reach productStore (the web flow via WebProductScreen already persists). Wire onSaved to persist exactly once. Small, self-contained; independent of the other FEATs.
steps: Confirm the contract: src/screens/product/AddEditProductScreen.tsx handleSave builds `saved: ProductMaster` and calls onSaved(saved) (prop type onSaved: (product: ProductMaster) => void). Persistence must happen in exactly ONE place — the navigator — not inside the screen.

In src/navigation/ProductNavigator.tsx, import useProductStore from '../store/productStore'. For the AddProduct screen, change onSaved to: (saved) => { useProductStore.getState().addProduct(saved); props.navigation.goBack(); }. For the EditProduct screen, change onSaved to: (saved) => { useProductStore.getState().updateProduct(saved.id, saved); props.navigation.goBack(); }.
Leave the web flow (WebProductScreen) completely untouched — it already persists; do not add a second persist call anywhere.

Verify ProductListScreen reads from useProductStore so the list reflects the change after returning (it should already; if it reads MOCK_PRODUCTS statically, note it in findings but do NOT expand scope beyond confirming the list updates — the store is the source the list must use).
acceptance_criteria: Adding a product through the mobile ProductList → AddProduct flow results in the product existing in useProductStore and appearing in the product list after goBack.
Editing a product through EditProduct updates the same productStore record (no duplicate) and the list reflects the change.
The web product flow is unchanged and products are persisted in exactly one place (the navigator) for the mobile flow.
`npm run lint` shows no new tsc errors; `npm test` shows no new failures.
verification: Run `npm run lint` and confirm no new tsc errors in ProductNavigator.tsx.
Run `npm test` and confirm no new failing suites.
Manual: on a mobile/narrow viewport, add a product and confirm it appears in the list on return; edit its name/price and confirm the single record updates.
findings: Wired persist in exactly ONE place (src/navigation/ProductNavigator.tsx): imported useProductStore from '../store/productStore'; AddProduct onSaved -> useProductStore.getState().addProduct(saved) then goBack; EditProduct onSaved -> useProductStore.getState().updateProduct(saved.id, saved) then goBack. AddEditProductScreen.handleSave only builds `saved: ProductMaster` and calls onSaved(saved) (and logAction for price changes on edit) — it does NOT persist, so no double-persist. Web flow (WebProductScreen) left untouched. productStore API confirmed: addProduct(product) and updateProduct(id, data). CAVEAT (noted, NOT fixed per scope): ProductListScreen.tsx does NOT read from useProductStore — it does `const [products] = useState<ProductMaster[]>(MOCK_PRODUCTS)` reading MOCK_PRODUCTS statically. So the store now holds the correct data after add/edit, but the mobile ProductListScreen will not reflect the change until it is switched to read from useProductStore. This is out of FEAT-003 scope (store is now the correct source of truth for the mobile persist path). lint: 13 pre-existing tsc errors in 6 files (baseline, unchanged) — ZERO new errors; ProductNavigator.tsx is clean. test: 24 pass, 3 suites fail to load (engine.test.ts, SyncService.test.ts, branchPermissionStore.test.ts) — all pre-existing baseline, no new failures.
